article.story: SAN LUIS OBISPO, Calif. -- — Ty Johnson had 21 points in UC Davis' 65-54 victory over Cal Poly on Thursday night. Johnson also had five rebounds for the Aggies (10-8, 4-3 Big West Conference). Pablo Tamba totaled 18 points, seven rebounds and three steals. Connor Sevilla scored 14. Mac Riniker finished with 18 points, seven rebounds and two steals for the Mustangs (6-13, 0-7), who have lost six in a row. Isaac Jessup added 12 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
